bridge_gates.B6: matched-pair coverage reported and every class has nonzero matched pairs and eligible positives

candidates.C0: unchanged Phase2B native logits and deployment

C1.abstain: cell with fewer than two eligible patches
C1.intervention: add delta to abnormal native logit at all three stages; normal logit unchanged
C1.name: MATCHED-RISK SCORE-SLOT ADJUDICATION
C1.slots: preserve descending original m_bar multiset within each acted eligible cell

C1_SHIFT.name: same C1 with E_nonlocal circular shift

conditioning.cells: score_bin x D_rank_bin; cell membership frozen before E_nonlocal
conditioning.d_rank_bins: 10 deterministic within-image quantile bins of pre-intervention D_rank
conditioning.risk: top ceil(0.20*1369) D_rank patches, descending D_rank then ascending patch index
conditioning.score_bins: 10 deterministic within-image quantile bins of m_bar

decision_gates.G0: all integrity, parity, GT firewall, deterministic, finite, and pretests pass
decision_gates.G2: macro AP delta > 0, AP CI lower > 0, >=8 positive classes, macro AUROC delta >= 0
decision_gates.G3: C1-C1_SHIFT AP mean > 0 and class-bootstrap lower CI > 0
decision_gates.G4: upper CI <= 0 for Normal delta FPR tau95, tau99, and negative risk
decision_gates.G5: native patch AP improves while deployed AP does not: deployment dilution

frozen_reuse.D_rank: population std of per-stage percentile ranks of native margins
frozen_reuse.E_nonlocal: B1 exact same-image low-risk peer rule, K=8
frozen_reuse.bootstrap: 2000 class-level resamples; seeds fixed in this file
frozen_reuse.deployment: Gaussian blur Industrial (7x7, sigma 1), bilinear align_corners=True, stage mean, softmax
frozen_reuse.matching: same-image positive/negative occupancy labels only after prediction freeze; deterministic SHA256 patch identity ordering; E never selects controls

normal.thresholds: class-wise C0 Normal tau95 and tau99 via numpy quantile
